actions.action: Register complete inline trip details with explicit trip-detail overrides taking precedence.
Use the existing context-only minimum-only model with no invented floor for 38 planning routes; retain missing-floor warnings.
Keep Boquet Willsboro–Noblewood, lower East Canada Creek, Murderkill Bowers loop and Miller Creek explicitly planning-only because their source notes publish no numeric scoring floor.
Recognize two intentional Bartram alternatives only when both routes reciprocally document the same alternative group.

Correct Guyandotte West Hamlin–Salt Rock risk designation to caution, retaining existing private-bank and access warnings; designate recreational proxies as planning without promoting proxy whitewater.
Reconcile three gauge-ledger rows with current route inventory; remove retired references and character-array corruption; retain the Erie Canal gauge as an existing-route guidance gap.

Separate the Adirondack Cedar River from the Iowa/Minnesota Cedar family, use the full Kinniconick chain as canonical, and add three pending-review corridor ledger records without granting new source approval.

Correct multi-day duration labels for Bitterroot Hannon–Chief Looking Glass, Androscoggin Errol–Shelburne and Saco Fryeburg–Dayton. Recognize existing staged trip descriptions for the other long routes; do not change their mileage.

Withhold Comal Hinman Island–Last Public Exit, remove scoring eligibility, and record an access conflict until a permitted entry coordinate and carry path are verified. Preserve the park marker rather than inventing a water-entry point.
Regenerate public geometry manifest and state bundles from existing reviewed assets; audit required controls only for non-withheld routes.
